description: Unique, canonical lower-case hyphenated slug identifier for the humanoid robot (e.g., figure-03, tesla-optimus-gen-2, unitree-g1).
benchmark_relevance: Primary key for dataset indexing and entity mapping.

description: Official commercial or research model name of the humanoid robot.
benchmark_relevance: Model display and categorical labeling in charts.

description: Corporate manufacturer or developer organization (e.g., Tesla, Figure AI, Unitree Robotics, Boston Dynamics, 1X Technologies).
benchmark_relevance: Manufacturer-level grouping and competitive market share benchmarking.

description: Normalized slug identifier for joining with manufacturers_summary table.
benchmark_relevance: Foreign key link to manufacturers_summary table.

description: Country where the humanoid robot architecture and engineering was designed (US, CN, NO, CA, ES, JP).
benchmark_relevance: Geopolitical and global robotics supply chain distribution.

description: Current commercial readiness stage: MASS_PRODUCTION, GENERAL_AVAILABILITY, PREORDER, EARLY_ACCESS, PILOT_DEPLOYMENT, PROTOTYPE, R_AND_D.
benchmark_relevance: Key classification target for technology maturity and time-to-market modeling.

description: Target end-user market tier: CONSUMER, COMMERCIAL, ENTERPRISE, RESEARCH.
benchmark_relevance: Target market segmentation.

description: Locomotion architecture: BIPEDAL (legged walking) vs WHEELED_BASE (omni-directional wheeled torso hybrid).
benchmark_relevance: Fundamental kinematic classification.

description: Primary operational focus: INDUSTRIAL, LOGISTICS, HOUSEHOLD, HEALTHCARE, RESEARCH, GENERAL.
benchmark_relevance: Application domain clustering.

description: Full list of secondary supported application domains and environment types.
benchmark_relevance: Multi-label domain categorization.

description: Standing vertical height of the robot from sole to apex of the head.
benchmark_relevance: Ergonomic comparison to human anthropometric 50th-percentile standards (~170 cm).

description: Total operating curb weight including onboard battery packs and actuators.
benchmark_relevance: Crucial for inertia, energy consumption, and human-collaborative safety compliance.

description: Maximum sustained payload carrying and manipulation capacity in dual-arm or single-arm operation.
benchmark_relevance: Industrial utility metric: determining industrial task suitability (automotive parts, totes).

description: Ratio of rated payload capacity to total robot mass (rated_payload_kg / mass_kg).
benchmark_relevance: Structural engineering efficiency score. Higher indicates advanced lightweight high-torque actuation.

description: Body Mass Index equivalent: mass_kg / ((height_cm/100)^2).
benchmark_relevance: Structural density comparison against biological human BMI distributions.

description: Total active motorized articulating joints throughout torso, neck, arms, legs, and waist.
benchmark_relevance: Kinematic complexity and motion flexibility.

description: Combined degrees of freedom across both dexterous robotic end-effectors / hands.
benchmark_relevance: Direct indicator of fine motor manipulation vs simple parallel pinch gripping.

description: Standard operating runtime on a full battery charge under typical dynamic walking/manipulation load.
benchmark_relevance: Shift compatibility (e.g., target 240–480 mins for industrial work shifts).

description: Nominal continuous bipedal walking speed on level ground (1.4 m/s is average human walking speed).
benchmark_relevance: Logistics throughput and cycle-time modeling.

description: Maximum sprint or peak dynamic displacement velocity under active balance control.
benchmark_relevance: Dynamic stability envelope.

description: Theoretical single-charge operating traverse range calculated as walking_speed_mps * (battery_runtime_min * 60) / 1000.
benchmark_relevance: Autonomous spatial mobility range.

description: Published MSRP, commercial pilot price, or consensus manufacturer estimate in USD.
benchmark_relevance: Economic ROI and cost-parity calculation against human labor ($/hour amortized).

description: Pricing basis: LIST (official MSRP), REPORTED (verified client quote), COMMERCIAL_PILOT, or ESTIMATED.
benchmark_relevance: Confidence weighting for financial modeling.

description: Autonomous intelligence level: AUTONOMOUS (end-to-end vision-language-action policy), COLLABORATIVE, TELEOPERATED, HYBRID.
benchmark_relevance: AI stack capability grading.

description: Disclosed primary hardware modules: onboard compute (Jetson Thor, FSD), vision sensors (RGBD, LiDAR), and actuators (FSA, harmonic drive).
benchmark_relevance: Supply chain component graph.

description: Flag indicating whether fingertips or palm are equipped with tactile pressure/haptic sensing arrays for closed-loop grasping.
benchmark_relevance: Advanced dexterous manipulation capability.

description: Documented optimal industrial, medical, household, or research use-cases.
benchmark_relevance: Task matching and qualitative NLP analysis.

description: Known technical constraints: thermal dissipation limits, uneven terrain stability, battery swap requirements.
benchmark_relevance: Risk assessment and future R&D benchmarking.

description: Official product slogan or technical one-line summary.
benchmark_relevance: Semantic summary.
